lang.playerTriedToBattleUnreachableGym: <red>You did not beat the previous gym yet, how did you get here?
lang.playerNotEnoughInventorySpace: <red>You don't have enough free space in inventory.
lang.playerCooldown: <yellow>This gym is on cooldown after the last {action}. Please wait {cooldown}
lang.invalidTargetArgument: <red>There is no player with this username or the uuid is invalid
lang.addProgressConfirmation: <green>Successfully added a win for {target} to gym {gym}

gyms.name: <bold>Pewter City
gyms.playerWonBattleMessage: Congratulations {user}! You've bested me. Take this boulder badge as proof of your victory.
gyms.playerLostBattleMessage: Guess you weren't strong enough to push this boulder in your path to become champion.

gyms.name: <bold>Cerulean City
gyms.playerWonBattleMessage: Congrats {user}! That was a good match and in return here is the Cascade badge.
gyms.playerLostBattleMessage: The tides were too strong hm? Better luck next time kid.

gyms.name: <bold>Vermilion City
gyms.playerWonBattleMessage: Congratulations {user}! You were a tough one I'll give you that. Here, take this Thunder Badge.
gyms.playerLostBattleMessage: Told you not to be too shocked, you are against a veteran after all.

gyms.name: <bold>Celadon City
gyms.playerWonBattleMessage: Congratulations {user}! I wish you a prosperous journey ahead of you as from this point on the gym challenge has now officially and properly begun. As proof I bestow upon you the Rainbow Badge.
gyms.playerLostBattleMessage: Sorry {trainer}, maybe you'll do better next time. Feel free to come again sometime.

gyms.name: <bold>Fuchsia City
gyms.playerWonBattleMessage: Well well {user}! You've done well against me. As expected here is the Soul Badge.
gyms.playerLostBattleMessage: Tough luck {trainer}.

gyms.name: <bold>Saffron City
gyms.playerWonBattleMessage: ...here is your Marsh Badge. Now leave.
gyms.playerLostBattleMessage: Try as you will {trainer}, No one can escape their fate I can foresee.

gyms.name: <bold>Cinnabar Island
gyms.playerWonBattleMessage: Congratulations {user}! You've bested an old man...you should be ashamed of yourself. Kidding, my you youngsters never have a sense of humor. Here is your Volcano Badge.
gyms.playerLostBattleMessage: Ohoho {trainer} did you at least bring a burn heal? Losing to an old man surely had to hurt your ego.

gyms.name: <bold>Viridian City
gyms.playerWonBattleMessage: You have potential {user}! If this Gym Challenge thing doesn't work out team rocket would like to have someone with your capabilities. Nonetheless here is your Earth Badge.
gyms.playerLostBattleMessage: You lost {trainer}, please vacate the premises.

gyms.name: <bold>Lorelei
gyms.playerWonBattleMessage: Congratulations {user}! You have beat your first Elite Four member, good luck against the rest. This is just the beginning.
gyms.playerLostBattleMessage: Frozen under pressure? Well I have absolute zero tolerance for that lukewarm performance.

gyms.name: <bold>Bruno
gyms.playerWonBattleMessage: As expected {user}! Your training and hard work have paid off! I'm glad to have lost to someone as hardworking as you. Please proceed on.
gyms.playerLostBattleMessage: You've lost our match {trainer}, that's okay. Show me your resolve in the future. Losing only builds a stronger person.

gyms.name: <bold>Agatha
gyms.playerWonBattleMessage: Ack, this stupid brat. Fine you win you may head on. I need to ask what Oak keeps feeding these danged trainers of his...
gyms.playerLostBattleMessage: Ahahahahaha. As expected of someone sent by Oak, good luck next time brat! You'll need it.

gyms.name: <bold>Lance
gyms.playerWonBattleMessage: Congratulations {user}! You have beat the final challenge of the Elite Four, in the next step the Champion awaits you.
gyms.playerLostBattleMessage: I told you {trainer}, the might of Dragon types are truly too stron-NO stop saying I used illegal Pokemon. I didn't cheat!

gyms.name: <#4097ED><b>Blue
gyms.playerWonBattleMessage: Congratulations {user}! You've...won. Shame, I've only just become Champion and I've already lost the title. What would Red think of me...ah enough of my self pity. Hold your head high Champion.
gyms.playerLostBattleMessage: Smell ya later {trainer}, as expected of the Kanto Champion. I truly am no pushover.

gyms.name: <bold>Violet City
gyms.playerWonBattleMessage: Congratulations {user}! You have beaten me thus starting your journey in Johto. I look forward to seeing how you handle the others in the Johto Gym challenge.
gyms.playerLostBattleMessage: Is this all Kanto's new champion has to offer? Talk about a weak region yeesh.

gyms.name: <bold>Azalea Town
gyms.playerWonBattleMessage: Wow {user}! My insects have never truly struggled like that. Guess you came prepared with bug repellent huh?
gyms.playerLostBattleMessage: Never underestimate the power of us Bug specialists. We may be few in number but we'll always find a way to come out on top

gyms.name: <bold>Goldenrod City
gyms.playerWonBattleMessage: Congratulations {user}! Most people tend to struggle against me after all I am infamous for it. But you didn't, guess all that training in Kanto really paid off huh?
gyms.playerLostBattleMessage: Miltank once again tramples the competition! Don't be too upset it's what we're known for.

gyms.name: <bold>Ecruteak City
gyms.playerWonBattleMessage: Congratulations {user}! You've now completed the half-way point of the Johto Gym challenge. At least when it comes to the leaders of course as the Elite 4 and Champion are in a whole other ballpark of their own.
gyms.playerLostBattleMessage: Sorry {trainer}, can't promise this loss won't haunt you for the rest of your career.

gyms.name: <bold>Cianwood City
gyms.playerWonBattleMessage: Behold {user}! This is the true strength of a specialized fighter such as myself.
gyms.playerLostBattleMessage: Good luck in the future {trainer}. I bestow upon you the 5th gym badge as well as an honorary black belt in my rankings

gyms.name: <bold>Olivine City
gyms.playerWonBattleMessage: The way you battle...maybe I was correct. You do remind me of a trainer who once helped me and Amphy
gyms.playerLostBattleMessage: No maybe I was incorrect. You do not remind me of that trainer who once helped me and Amphy. They would never be crushed under the weight of my steel Pokemon.

gyms.name: <bold>Mahogany Town
gyms.playerWonBattleMessage: My my {user} was it? You young folk truly are the sun that melts the harsh cold of the future. You have so much potential, go on prove it to the world kid.
gyms.playerLostBattleMessage: Hm {trainer} if you cannot weather the storm it may be best to throw in the towel. No shame in that.

gyms.name: <bold>Blackthorn City
gyms.playerWonBattleMessage: Leave {user}! You are not worthy of this badge, to approach the presence of Lan-you know what? Forget it. Just take the badge.
gyms.playerLostBattleMessage: You lost {trainer}, now run along and never come back again. Just quit the Johto challenge actually so someone as amazing as Lance will never have the displeasure of seeing you fail.

gyms.name: <bold>Will
gyms.playerWonBattleMessage: Outprediciting a Psychic specialist? I'm impressed {user}! You have triumphed against me in a battle of wits, continue your journey as the other Elite 4 members shall await you.
gyms.playerLostBattleMessage: Oh no no that will never do. I can't forsee a better outcome for you. While I'm predicting you're guessing and that's the difference between us.

gyms.name: <bold>Koga
gyms.playerWonBattleMessage: What a wonderful match {user}! It was truly nice seeing you again. I hope we may cross paths in the future again once we have both reached new heights.
gyms.playerLostBattleMessage: Oh {trainer}? that's okay. Succumbing to the poison that easily? My where was the passion you showed in our battle in Kanto?

gyms.name: <bold>Bruno
gyms.playerWonBattleMessage: It was fancy seeing you again squirt. Come by and spar with me in the future, I'll see if I can train harder.
gyms.playerLostBattleMessage: Looks like I have bested you this time. Challenge me once more when you've trained to higher standards.

gyms.name: <bold>Karen
gyms.playerWonBattleMessage: Hmph I guess congrats {user}. I guess I underestimated you. I guess appearances can be deceiving.
gyms.playerLostBattleMessage: This is what the other Elite Four members lost to? We really need to recruit better members is this what we've come to? I have to be the one to stop the brat?

gyms.name: <#1717FF><b>Lance
gyms.playerWonBattleMessage: Congratulations {user}! You have once again bested me and my dragons. This time I shall be handing over the title of champion. I will admit I am a little saddened as I've just barely gotten promoted...nonetheless you have earned it.
gyms.playerLostBattleMessage: See I told you I didn't need any cheated Dragonites for thi-I mean. Ahem. You were a formidable battle as expected however it seems as of taking the champion position I am the one who has grown more.
